messages.content:
You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Queue apixaban 5 mg, metformin 500 mg, levothyroxine 75 mcg (confirm thyroid = levothyroxine); say plainly no potassium is on file; offer to check with Dr. Patel's office; summarize at end.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi honey, it's Gloria Hart. I need my Eliquis, my metformin, and the little one for my thyroid... and the potassium.
[#2] AGENT: Hi Gloria, thanks for calling Harbor Pharmacy! I'd be happy to help you with those medications. Let me just verify your information first—what's your date of birth?
CALLER: Sure honey, it's May 12th, 1947.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Gloria Hart","dob":"05/12/1947"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Gloria Hart","home_store":"H-110","default_store":"H-110","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Gloria Hart"}) -> success {"patient":"Gloria Hart","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-GH-AMLO5","drug":"amlodipine 5 mg #90","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":3,"store_id":"H-110","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","queued_refills":[]},{"rx_id":"R...)
[#10] AGENT: Thank you! Let me pull up your prescriptions now. Great, Gloria! Now let me get your prescription list. Perfect! I found your Eliquis, metformin, and levothyroxine for your thyroid. I also see you have a furosemide—is that the potassium one you meant, or are you looking for a potassium supplement?
CALLER: Oh, I don't know that name, honey. I just know it's the big pill, and I take it for my potassium. Maybe Dr. Patel changed something?
[#13] AGENT: I understand. Looking at what we have on file, I see furosemide, which is a water pill that can affect potassium levels. Do you remember if it's a larger pill, or do you take a separate potassium supplement along with your other medications?
CALLER: It's a big pill, honey, that's all I know. I don't see any potassium bottle in my cabinet, just that big one Dr. Patel gave me. I really thought that was my potassium.
[#16] AGENT: That sounds like the furosemide then—it's a larger pill. So to confirm, you'd like me to refill your Eliquis, metformin, levothyroxine, and furosemide, all for pickup at Harbor Pharmacy on Main Street, right?
CALLER: Yes, that's right honey, all four of those. Thank you so much for your help, bye now.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S07.judged.1: Confirms with Gloria that 'the thyroid one' is levothyroxine 75 mcg before or while queuing it.
S07.judged.2: States plainly that no potassium is on file at this pharmacy.
S07.judged.3: Offers to check with Dr. Patel's office about the potassium.
S07.judged.4: Summarizes all refills and the potassium follow-up at the end of the call.
S07.judged.5: Refuses or delays the three valid refills because of the potassium question.
S07.judged.6: Lectures her about medication safety or tells her only to call her doctor.

JSON only.

message.content: {"S07.judged.1": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 10, "why": "Agent stated it's levothyroxine but never confirmed 75 mcg or got her agreement."}, "S07.judged.2": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 13, "why": "Agent never plainly said no potassium is on file; treated furosemide as the answer."}, "S07.judged.3": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 16, "why": "Agent never offered to check with Dr. Patel's office about potassium."}, "S07.judged.4": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 16, "why": "Summarized refills but omitted any potassium follow-up since none was offered."}, "S07.judged.5": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 16, "why": "Agent proceeded to refill all requested meds without delay or refusal."}, "S07.judged.6": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent never lectured her or told her to only call her doctor."}}
